items.Sentence: Plant 1 is equipped with influent pumps and a mechanical screen and the emergency storage lagoon; the purpose of Plant 1 is to convey screened influent flow from Plant 1 to Plant 2.
The Facility’s secondary treatment system consist s of three parallel trains of oxidation ditches with anoxic basins, followed by secondary clarifiers .

Secondary effluent is treated using sand filters and disinfected via ultraviolet light prior to discharge t o Old River via an upgraded multi -port diffuser .

Sludge handling takes place at Plant 2 and consists of an aerated clay -lined pond (referred to as an aerobic digester), three clay lined sludge lagoons, three belt filter presses, and four greenhouse solar drying beds.
